rule.title: The owner's own health insurance is not a Schedule C expense

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item health insurance (an accident and health plan) for the owner, the owner's spouse or dependents, rather than for employees?

citation.wording: Do not include on line 14 any contributions you made on your behalf as a self-employed person to an accident and health plan.

rule.open_point: The figure is counted 0.00 on Schedule C and not moved: the self-employed health insurance deduction (Schedule 1 line 17) is limited and worked by the preparer's software, so it is not a line this sheet places on.
